# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About N&N AFFORDABLE BUNDLES
A data bundle reselling business that operates across all mobile networks, offering customers flexible internet data packages. The business caters to a broad market by providing multi-network coverage, making it a one-stop shop for data connectivity needs.
